topic: Parts of the Nose and Their Functions
key_concepts: The nose is the sense organ for smelling
Nostrils are the two openings of the nose
Air passes through the nasal cavity
Cilia are tiny hairs inside the nose
Cilia filter dust and other particles
Mucus membrane warms and moistens air entering the nose
Olfactory nerve sends smell messages to the brain
Hard palate and soft palate are parts of the nose
Avoid inserting small objects inside the nose
Cover the nose when passing a dusty road
Consult a doctor when there is discomfort with the nose
